top_signals.title: KKR-Backed Advanta Said to Start Road Show for $400 Million IPO
top_signals.summary: KKR & Co.-backed Advanta Enterprises Ltd. has begun investor meetings for a proposed initial public offering in India that could raise as much as $400 million, according to people familiar with the matter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: China posts weakest industrial profit growth this year, expanding 4.2% in August
top_signals.summary: Economists expect Beijing to lean harder on stimulus to stabilize corporate profitability, as consolidation accelerates in sectors facing sluggish demand and fierce competition.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
